input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
errors: First smoke run: the rise from zero had no plan at the G1's high poses because a leaned stance balances only above 4-12 N of press; fixed by starting the rise where the stance balances (disclosed post hoc in LOG and run.py), which became the milestone's main finding.
Guessed a citation title for Buchalter et al. 2002 in a first draft of the bib; caught before commit and replaced with the title from a catalogue search.

doc_friction.issue: New author-year citations must also be added to its CITES list or tests/test_latex.py fails with 'unconverted citations'; nothing in the paper README or research CLAUDE.md says so.
pyenv.py returned /usr/bin/python3.13 at once (it already had mujoco and scipy), so the 'run it in the background, can take minutes' advice did not apply here; harmless.

deviations.why: The registered model started the rise at F_r; the smoke run showed the leaned poses do not balance there.
deviations.did: Started the rise at each pose's lowest balancing press, disclosed as a post hoc change, and reported the balance limit itself as a finding.
deviations.result: Run completed on every pose but one; the stance finding is the headline consequence.

deviations.why: Unregistered post hoc census of window straddlers added to explain why no joint was set.
deviations.did: Kept it in a separate posthoc.py/posthoc.txt, labelled not registered.
deviations.result: Shows 36 of 56 loose joints change sign in the window.

notes: Routed research/0 by weighted draw; pick_track drew buildbot-sheathing. Milestone 40: recoil bracket 0.087-8.7 N s from published data; quasi-static re-press sets none of 56 loose joints; 0.012 mm spec stands; 12 of 35 leaned stances need 3.7-11.8 N press to balance. Local checks: tests 204 passed 4 skipped; check_numbers 330/330; homepage build ok; check_md_links ok; cite_check ok for the new DOI. Full run 1061 s on 4 processes.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: sourcing the recoil bracket, writing and running a quasi-static re-press model on an existing whole-body stack, and the write-ups: a research engineer's two working days

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
